summary: Comprehensive testing of vMix Director feature for Server sites. Backend: 17/17 tests PASSED. Frontend: All UI components working - Canvas preview with 5 draggable overlay elements, element toggle switches, type-specific settings panels (Logo upload, Clock format/colors, Ticker separators/scrolling/messages, Now Playing XML server linking), Save Configuration, vMix Overlay URLs with Copy functionality.

minor.issue: Missing X-Main-Site-ID header returns 200 with main_site_id=null instead of 400. Works but not ideal validation.

design_issues.screen: vMix Director - Ticker/Now Playing color inputs
issues: Console warning: '#000000cc' hex color with alpha not valid for HTML5 color input. Works visually but logs warning.

seed_data_creation: One TEST_ prefixed ticker message was created during testing and cleaned up via API delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: vMix Director feature is fully functional. Key verified flows: 1) /clara-xml-server/vmix-director loads canvas with 5 overlay elements (logo, clock, ticker, now_playing_show, now_playing_track). 2) Clicking element in sidebar shows type-specific settings panel with position/size controls. 3) Ticker settings include separator buttons (bullet/dash/pipe/star/custom), scrolling toggle, text/bg colors, font size. 4) Ticker messages can be added via input field and + button, deleted via trash icon. 5) Element toggles enable/disable visibility on canvas. 6) Save Configuration calls PUT /api/vmix/config and shows success toast. 7) vMix Overlay URLs section shows 5 Copy URL buttons that copy public HTML overlay endpoints. 8) All overlay endpoints are public (no auth) for vMix Web Browser Input to load.

passed: GET /api/vmix/config returns default config with 5 elements
PUT /api/vmix/config saves updated configuration and returns updated data
Config includes all expected fields (canvas_bg, ticker_separator, ticker_scroll, clock_format, etc.)
POST /api/vmix/logo/upload accepts image files and returns logo_url
POST /api/vmix/logo/upload rejects non-image files with 400
POST /api/vmix/ticker-messages creates message with id, text, order, active, created_at
GET /api/vmix/ticker-messages returns list of messages
PUT /api/vmix/ticker-messages/{id} updates message text and active status
DELETE /api/vmix/ticker-messages/{id} deletes message and returns {status: 'deleted'}
GET /api/vmix/overlay/{id}/logo returns HTML page
GET /api/vmix/overlay/{id}/clock returns HTML with JavaScript clock
GET /api/vmix/overlay/{id}/ticker returns HTML with scrolling/static ticker
GET /api/vmix/overlay/{id}/now-playing-show returns HTML with JS fetch for show data
GET /api/vmix/overlay/{id}/now-playing-track returns HTML with JS fetch for track data
All overlay endpoints work without authentication (public for vMix to load)
GET /api/vmix/xml-servers returns list of server-type sites with id, name, slug
GET /api/vmix/now-playing/{id} returns structure with show and track fields (null when no XML server linked)
Canvas with 16:9 aspect ratio displays all 5 enabled overlay elements
Elements show appropriate preview (Logo image, Clock time, Ticker messages, Now Playing labels)
Elements are positioned according to config (Logo top-left, Clock top-right, Ticker bottom, Now Playing lower third)
Shows list of 5 elements with colored icons
Each element has toggle switch that enables/disables canvas visibility
Clicking element row shows type-specific settings panel
All elements show X/Y position and Width/Height percentage inputs
Logo settings show file upload input with current logo preview
Clock settings show format dropdown (HH:mm:ss, HH:mm), text/bg color inputs, font size
Ticker settings show scrolling toggle, separator buttons (5 options), custom separator input when 'custom' selected, text/bg colors, font size
Now Playing settings show XML Server Source dropdown with list of server sites
Shows list of ticker messages with active indicator dot
Add message via input field + plus button works (Message added toast)
Delete message via trash icon button works
Shows 5 overlay types with Copy URL button and external link icon
Copy URL button triggers clipboard copy (toast shows 'URL copied to clipboard')
Save Configuration button calls PUT /api/vmix/config
Success toast 'Configuration saved' appears after save
